definitions.explanation: Something one is required to do by law, morality, or social expectation.

examples.japanese: {税金|ぜいきん}を{払|はら}う{義務|ぎむ}がある。
examples.english: I have an obligation to pay taxes.

examples.japanese: {義務|ぎむ}{教育|きょういく}は6{歳|さい}から{始|はじ}まる。

notes:
{義務|ぎむ} refers to legal, moral, or social duties.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {義務|ぎむ}がある (to have an obligation)
- {義務|ぎむ}を{果|は}たす (to fulfill one's duty)
- {義務|ぎむ}を{負|お}う (to bear an obligation)

COMPOUND WORDS:
- {義務|ぎむ}{教育|きょういく} (compulsory education)
- {義務|ぎむ}{化|か} (making mandatory)
- {義務|ぎむ}{違反|いはん} (breach of duty)

RELATED PAIR:
- {権利|けんり}と{義務|ぎむ} (rights and obligations)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {義務|ぎむ}: duty (formal, legal)
- {責任|せきにん}: responsibility
- {務|つと}め: duty (literary)
